However, two issues prevent a perfect score: (1) The plumage texture, especially the blue-to-white belly transition, appears artificially smooth and airbrushed, lacking fine feather micro-detail (severity 1 texture anomaly per Router). (2) The animal_pose_auditor flagged HIGH artifact risk (49% low-confidence keypoints), indicating underlying anatomical uncertainty despite clean surface appearance. The feet-to-branch interaction shows minor ambiguity in toe definition. These factors justify a moderate penalty but not severe downgrading.

self_reflection_notes.reasoning_for_change: The initial assessment correctly identified the texture anomaly but underweighted its impact when combined with the pose auditor's HIGH risk signal. While neither issue alone would justify more than a 0.5-point deduction, their co-occurrence suggests systemic generative artifacts beneath an otherwise clean surface. The 0.1-point reduction reflects this compounding effect without over-penalizing, staying within the guideline that a single severity-1 issue should not drop authenticity by more than 0.5.
